name: Of Rose and Moon
source:
A powerful dungeon lies in the depths of the earth, filled with lavish treasures. Enticed by the promise of wealth, many adventurers traverse the dangerous underground maze, only to be halted at the very last chamber where Callistra, the Final Boss, lies in wait. She is a powerful magic wielder and no one has yet to best her in battle. Many adventuring parties have given up trying to challenge Callistra at all, leaving the dungeons before reaching the Final Boss. 

In turn, Callistra has become terribly bored of her position and wishes to be free from it. Her monotonous life is finally broken up by Ruth, a brave knight that refuses to give up in defeating the Final Boss and defeating the dungeon once and for all. Both are evenly matched and should be wary of the other, but instead other emotions arise instead... 

[From [url=https://studioyaya.itch.io/of-rose-and-moon]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个强大的地牢位于大地深处，里面充满了丰富的宝藏。受到财富承诺的诱惑，许多冒险家穿越了危险的地下迷宫，却在最后的房间里停下来，最终大佬卡利斯特拉就在那里等待。她是一位强大的魔法使用者，迄今为止还没有人在战斗中击败过她。许多冒险队伍已经放弃了挑战卡莉丝特拉的尝试，在到达最终Boss之前就离开了地下城。

反过来，卡莉丝特拉对自己的处境感到非常厌倦，并希望摆脱它。她单调的生活终于被露丝打破了，她是一位勇敢的骑士，不肯放弃，打败了最终boss，一劳永逸地打败了地牢。两人势均力敌，本该警惕对方，却反而产生了其他的情绪…… 

[来自[url=https://studioyaya.itch.io/of-rose-and-moon]itch.io[/url]]
